scientific_integrity: The scalar metric dimension 3 is credited as previously known; the claimed contribution is the exact antipodal-pair characterization of every ordinary vertex-resolving set and the consequent complete polynomial. Reproducible finite verification and a mathematical proof are provided; no independence or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is limited to the fixed dodecahedral graph P(10,2); no conclusion is asserted for other graph parameters or stronger/mixed resolution. The 2008 family-dimension paper is available as abstract and citation but its full text could not be inspected for precise priority comparison. Earlier equivalent enumerations are possible.
title: Antipodal-pair criterion and complete resolving polynomial of the dodecahedral graph
